spec: Rebuild the app in DOM at true scale, 1200-1320px wide, with its top edge at 58% of the viewport and its base cut by the fold. 1px ink-8% border, radius 12-14, no shadow. 240px sidebar with 13/28 rows; main pane a raised sheet inset 8px. One live state.

Outer shell 1080-1248px, tinted ink-5%, radius 16, 1px line. 32-34px title bar with dots or a breadcrumb. App sheet inset 8px on three sides, radius 8-10, its own 1px line. 250px sidebar on a half-step tint, 14/28 rows. Never show the bottom edge.

Window or shell with 1px line and radius 16-24 dissolves into the page: mask the lower third, or the right and bottom edges, to page colour. Text stays real and dims with distance. No hard base, no shadow halo, no fake window edge.

Column-wide plate 480-640px tall, painted image or tinted panel, radius 0 or 48. Window inset 24-35px at the sides and 50px at the top, cropped by the plate base. Radius 12, 1px edge, soft 18/50 shadow. All colour lives on the plate; the UI stays neutral.

Panel 660-1390px, radius 8-12, real texture or interior photograph with fine grain. App window centred or inset 48-90px, soft shadow, radius 8-12. Optional faux 11px menu bar across the top. Texture stays low contrast, so the window keeps the eye.

Dashboard 1080-1200px with no chrome, radius 8-12, layered shadow, real nav, chart and table. It straddles a section change: the next section's angled edge or colour break hides its base. It must never simply end inside one section.

Main window 800-1100px wide plus one smaller panel 296-436px overlapping an edge by 40-120px. Panel has its own fill, radius 12-16 and a soft shadow, or on dark a lighter fill and no shadow. Window shows context, panel shows the feature.

No window. A tinted panel about 845px wide is the app: oversized search line in display type, a hairline, then 4 masonry columns of 170px with a 16px gap mixing photos, quotes, highlighted notes and price tags.

1080px browser frame, app dimmed by a dark gradient that fades to page colour at the base. Centred 500px white modal, 1px accent border, soft matching glow, 56px rows split by hairlines. Supporting logos overlap its lower edge.

Window about 1230px, radius 24, 1px ink-14% border, dots left, view toggles right. Three panes: 200px file list, mono code centre, rendered output right on a soft radial glow. Selecting a file tints it and changes code and output together.

Black stage about 1190x550, radius 20, one dim colour glow in a corner. Real editor window offset right and down, clipped by the right and bottom edges, 1px light border, radius 20. Sliders and toggles stay legible at true scale.

Row of 3-4 equal tabs, 48px tall with 1px dividers, docked to the frame top and sharing its border. Active tab tinted with a 2px accent top line, label 16/600. Screenshot inset 40px inside the frame with its own 1px border. Tabs swap the whole view.

Product 750-900px wide, flush to the right gutter or bleeding off the viewport. Small 11-13px UI left unretouched, 1px border, radius 10. Copy large on the left. No shadow on dark pages; light chrome bar optional on light ones.
Dark screen 800-880px wide, 3-4px bezel in a pale accent, soft outer glow, radius 20, no window chrome. One small notch or hardware hint at most. It reads as a device without drawing one.

Recorded product video 1000-1200px wide with UI text readable at 11-12px, radius 12-24, cropped or fully framed. A 36-40px circular pause button sits in a corner. Use a different recording per section; never one clip reused.

Screenshot about 400x300, radius 12, soft shadow. Behind it two flat plates rotated -3 and +3 degrees, one dark and one accent, each showing a single corner. Repeat the identical stack on every feature row.

Two-up small windows 8-12 radius, 1px border, true chrome colours per channel, around 11px type. Use skeleton bars only when the point is the channel rather than the content. Prefer one real window over this.

Grey well or hairline tile, radius 14-20. One real component centred at true 13-15px: white card, 1px border, radius 12-14. No scale, tilt or window chrome. Give each well one state, such as a tooltip or a checked row.

Redraw product UI in brand geometry: deep brand fill, 2px white outline and one accent chip; or a notched card with an inverted corner; or 1.5px ink-stroked widgets. Shape and colour come from the brand, the data stays real.

Portrait or textured photo, radius 6-20. One sharp card pinned low, inset 20px, radius 16, 60px rows of 14px type. Or 270px frosted cards at 85% white. Photo stays at real scale, card carries all the detail, and one row fades to imply life.

One menu or dialog at 1-2x over its app faded to 30%: 392px white menu, radius 12, soft shadow, selected row filled with a 2px accent bar, shortcut chips. A large cursor rests on the row. Keycaps may overlap the edge.

White nodes 160-216 by 52-74px, radius 6-12, 1px line, active 1px accent. Rounded elbow connectors, 7px ports. Status chips above nodes: green completed, accent running. Unfired paths grey. 16-28px dot grid on a tint. Bleed off one edge.

Panel 292-538px, radius 12-16, 1px line. Dark or tinted user bubble, plain 13-14/18-20 reply with bold findings, a Thinking line, a Changes box with Undo, composer with model picker and 24px icons. No avatars on messages.

Table bleeding off a tinted cell's right and bottom edges. 13-14px, rows 36-38px or 60 relaxed, hairlines, tabular right-aligned numbers, 12px grey headers, 16px logos, tinted score chips. Invent specific entities. One row selected. Crop it; do not fade early.

Real working UI inline with no frame: a 1136px search with four selects, a count and a pager; or 52x76 date chips with masked ends; or a typed block with a caret. Full size, keyboard reachable, and it must work on a phone.

Stack of 51-60px rows or sentence-rows with status chips, each row dimmer than the last: 100, 70, 40, 15%. 12px mono names, 9-12px status chips, timestamps. Mask or blur the base. A new row can arrive at the top.

evidence.name: Airpost: The Frontier Marketing OS for Frontier Companies

spec: Two or three white panels with 10-13px type, radius 6-14, overlapping at two depths on a rich gradient that leaks around them, soft tinted shadow, cropped by the card edge. Real labels, segmented controls, plans and prices.

Panel 540-1080px, radius 8, 1px dividers, real settings: sliders, count pills, ticks or ring progress, accordion rows. True 13-15px text. Right half may tint one step. Around 60px soft shadow. Ghost the chrome to 10% contrast, if used.

UI drawn as a physical thing: a 384px note with a perforated edge, cards rotated 5 degrees, tags rotated 10 hanging off a sheet, soft 20/40 shadow. Specific human content. A slight break of the grid gives flat UI a handled quality.

Product panel 400-480px wide with no frame on page colour. Mask right and bottom into the page. Text 11-13px, dim except one focal row at full ink. Optional raised card in front with a lighter fill, no glow. 60px air above and below.

One real control scaled 1.5-2x inside a tile and cropped by its edge: a pill, keycap or field with a click ring and cursor. Frosted white fields, radius 14, or about 100px of air each side if uncropped. No window.

Real UI cards joined by 1px dashed or thin accent connectors. Greyed source pills feed a 240px status card with a 44px icon tile and four 11px mono states on a dot-line. White cards, soft shadow, pale panel, radius 4-16.

Vertical list on a 1px connector with 32px icon tiles, then either token chips forming a sentence at 16-18px, or Failed, Retry and Paid steps with dates at the right. One step boxed in 1px accent, radius 8.

Tray 692x406, radius 16, 1px border, holding two equal 322px white windows with one prompt and two outcomes. Or a 1078px container split 50/50, pale column and dark column. A single accent marks the better result.

Single white card 340-440px, radius 24-32, hue-tinted 24px shadow, on a pale wash. 40px drawn icon tile, 16px name, 14px muted detail, right-aligned amount. One object, no frame. Add a faded card behind for depth.

The product's own overlay as a page constant: about 110px round camera over a shot with a control pill, or a 366x60 dock of 40px icons, idle at 40% with an active dot, or a 296px widget 24px from the corner.

Two or three cards, radius 20-24, the middle one wider and overlapping: status chips, 40px metric in accent, bar spark with 1hr, 30m, Now labels, shadow 0 8 24. Or dark tiles that overlap and bleed off every edge.

400px tinted card, radius 16. Three 52px chips, radius 12, active one solid. A white result bubble below at 16/600 changes per chip. Or a prompt box with template chips and theme swatches. One control, one visible change.

Code beside its live output, split 50/50 or 40/60. Window about 1150px, radius 18, 1px line, filename bar, mono 13-14/20-24. Output is real: rendered email, running visualiser, flow diagram on a dotted pane. Change one and the other responds.

Code pane about 555x340 beside a 225-258px rail of topics or files: 11-12px mono caps rows with hairlines, or 16px items, active row tinted with a 2px bar. A note pinned to the rail base. Fade the code at the bottom.

White card, 1px hairline, radius 8-12, 48px header with dots, 13px mono filename and a real control at right, such as a run-target select. Mono 13/20 with three token colours. Clip mid-line at the cell bottom, or pair with a chat column.

Panel 544-1024px, radius 12-24, 1px line. Language or framework tabs: 60x56 icon tiles or 90px tabs split by hairlines, active brightened, copy icon right. Mono 13-14/20-22, line numbers at 30% ink, one accent for strings.

Full-bleed saturated band. Copy left, H2 at 32px. Right, a near-black card about 600x326, radius 8, language header over hairline, mono 12, soft shadow. The endpoint string changes over time. Or pair two unequal windows, top-aligned at different heights.

POST pill, mono URL, hairline, 14-16px mono JSON with a single warm string colour, hairline, footer with install command, tiny sparkline and language circles. Or a deep tinted pane with one call, dim line numbers 1-10 and a block caret.

Dark code panel about 500px, radius 4-12, with run and copy icons, laid over a light dashboard or brand card. Three depths: terminal, object, dashboard bleeding off the right. One tinted panel behind holds them together.

Panel about 880px, radius 12, mono 14/24, line numbers at 30% ink. Changed rows get a tinted band plus a coloured gutter number, and the exact token a 30% tint. Keep syntax colour on. Right column fades out, overlapping a real list at 85%.

Near-black outer radius 12 with 30px header of filename and copy icon. Inner lighter panel inset 4px, radius 8, mono 14/20. Highlighted lines get a 2px accent bar and tinted row. Works repeated, as every block in a doc.

Frameless grey mono 14/20 on page grain, or a black pane at 16/24. Each step gets a 2px rounded left bracket: green done, red with 10% tint running. Status pills such as COMPLETED | 1.2S hang in the left margin. State is the only colour.

Code panel cropped by the card edge on the left 43%, top-right radius 20, 1px top highlight. 11px language tabs. Every line at 25% ink except the single method line at full ink. Serves as texture with one readable point.

Panel about 1200px, 1px line, radius 4. 44px tinted header: mono POST, path, two payload toggles. Request on white, 201 response on a pale success tint, 13/22 mono, one live value highlighted. Toggles swap the payload.

Box 680x48-60, 1px line, radius 0-4, mono 14, copy icon in its own divided cell at right. No window dots, prompt symbol or syntax colour. Paper-like sites can add a hard 3px offset shadow with no blur.
Inside body copy: mono 13-16px in a 26px chip, radius 4-6, 1px line, faint fill, optional copy icon at right. It sits within the line height, so the paragraph keeps its rhythm.

Warm-black panel, radius 12, mono 12/19. Header: host, region, outlined status pill with dot. Subheader: cron plus cpu and mem bars. Log: grey comments, accent prompt, green bullets, tree connectors, block cursor. The last step is in progress.

The command is the hero action. 52px pill, hairline plus soft shadow, muted $, mono 14, 16px copy icon. Or 60px ink block, mono 16, accent $, copy in a separate clipped-corner cell, OS toggle below. Or a quiet 35px bar under the CTAs.

Box about 720px with 13px mono tabs for npm, pnpm and friends, active one boxed or underlined, hairline, one coloured command line, copy tile bottom right. Optional dashed frame offset 5px outside a solid one.

Module about 745px, radius 14, 2px near-black frame. Mono caps labels, a grey prompt pill with three agent icons and copy button, then two 1px command boxes with one syntax colour. Repeat it verbatim at the closing CTA.
Framework dropdown, a one-line 16px sentence, then a dark code block about 950x120 with copy icon. Two brand characters lean in from both sides. The joke is on the block, not beside it.

Dark terminal, radius 6, three dots, mono 12, green diamonds on steps, later lines fading out. Overlapped by the resulting UI, as a skeleton card in a tray. Spinner and a short caption below. Depth comes from overlap.

Window about 410px, radius 8-12, dots, mono 13/23, credible output, rising from the card base on a pale fade or grain panel and cropped by the edge. A separate chip such as a ready line can float above.
Panel 720-1120px, radius 4, mono 14-16 typing one command with a caret, then output. Prompt chips with line number, truncated text and Copy sit below. Start half-typed so the panel is never blank.

Phone drawn as a thin steel rim on black, about 440px wide, cropped by the section base. Black screen, one 48px number with small decimals, grey round actions. Or a 1px white-40% outline with no bezel over a shader.

Window at the fold, phone 200-220px wide overlapping its lower right by 60px, 2px rim, radius 40, real content at about 14px. Depth comes from overlap alone. On light pages add a soft shadow and floating action pills between them.
Real hands hold a tablet or phone tilted about 8 degrees, rising from the section bottom, cropped. Legible UI on screen, cool rim light. Centred two-tone 40px heading above: white, then 50% white.

Phone frame on a pale ground, screen faded to 30%. White cards 120x168, radius 24, overlap both phone edges with 76px progress rings and short labels. Or chips 196x66, radius 8, soft shadow, at staggered heights over a bezel.

Video phone about 270x555, radius 32, white bezel, 3px gradient stroke drawn along only part of the edge. Landscape tablet tucked behind, joined by a thin line. Overlays such as a pose skeleton and 9/10 score sit on the video.

Phone with no hardware detail, about 300x590, radius 44, 4px pale rim, wide soft shadow. Real checkout at 12-14px: wallet button, stacked 1px inputs, Pay button. A receipt card behind and a toast crossing both. Right edge sits on the page guide.

Three phones. Either fanned, centre forward at 400px, side phones 120-200px lower, clipped, bottoms fading to the ground; or stacked three-quarter renders on the centre axis with elliptical floor shadows. UI redrawn in brand style.

Skew or rotate 8 degrees, black face, 1px bright rim highlight on one corner, a second offset outline behind, cropped by the card base. Or a macro 3D render at a steep angle filling the frame. Never a gentle floating tilt.

Phone centred under the heading, cropped by scroll or by a 466px tile, radius 20. Feature notes flank left and right in staggered rows, active note on a pale card, each with a 56px icon square. Offset the tops.
Horizontal rail of editor window, phone and CLI, all dark, top aligned, 240-520px wide, 14px captions beneath, clipped at the right to hint at more. The same session content appears on each surface.

The same phone, about 245px, holds its position across chapters while the screen swaps: product, payment sheet, coupon, dashboard. Oversized props tied to each message sit around it. Copy scrolls past.
Black-bezel tablets, radius 32, cropped by section edges across a two-colour split, holding real charts and order lists. Devices run off screen and are never shown whole.

Square photo about 615px with white pills floating over and past its edges, soft shadow: words, swatch plus word. Height varies 22-50px to imply depth, and grows on scroll. Annotation without leader lines.

Exploded render about 560px centred, with six callouts outside it: 12px mono caps, grey [+] prefix, on a 1px rule about 300px long ending in a 3px dot on the part. Uneven heights, both sides. Or run dotted lines up to outlined SKU pills.

Key UI rows lift out as wider white bands, bracketed by 1px frames with 6px corner handles. Or corner reticles with a centred cross and 10px labels. Or layer a tinted redline box labelled with a mono width.

Isometric slabs stacked, with 16px labels and short dash leaders at left. Fill steps through one hue from white to full accent, so the diagram is the explanation. One slab in the accent marks the new layer. Works at 390px.

Native diagram: mono boxes radius 4-6, 1px lines with small nodes, pale numbered discs 01-03 along the path, dashed trust boundary, one accent VERIFIED tag, tracked 11px mono captions. Pin beside scrolling copy.
Dim dark UI shot with a circular lens about 300px, 4px gradient ring, showing the key lines enlarged at full brightness. The lens says which detail matters without a caption.
Snippet about 480px with only a 1px left and bottom rule, a pale red error row with a red bar. Accent mono notes at 14-16px rotated 3-4 degrees sit in the margins, linked by hand-drawn black arrows.

Rebuilt IDE about 975px. Inactive panes under a tinted wash, active pane pure. White 390px callout, radius 4, glowing accent edge, 26px mono title, 16px copy. A cursor arrow travels between stops as scroll advances.
Three columns: 20px paragraph, three verbs stacked at 56px with the active word white and others 25%, then a 280px dark device showing the matching controls. Scroll advances the verb.

spec: Room render or photo about 800px, radius 14-20. Rings 30px translucent with 14px white centres on each part, matched by a card alongside. Or green skeleton dots with a counter overlaid on a person.

Frame about 576x464 with deep fill, 2px rim, radius 24, hairline spectrum top and bottom. Two overlapping screens inside, light over dark, real data. A simple variant sets a small grey label left and a large photo right, alternating.

Dot field 16px pitch. Nodes radius 12, 1px border, mono 15px real identifiers, 8px square status dots. 1px grey arrows with tiny heads. Use actual state names. Ghost unused nodes as outlines fading into the grid.

Sphere of 2-4px dots with continents in a dot matrix. Small chips with mono 10px city, department and local-currency amount pin to dots, or 10px accent squares mark regions with a scrolling mono country list beside it.

1px ink box, 46px tab row with active tab solid. Rows 44px: name plus mono version, 28px tinted track, solid bar on one shared scale, right-aligned mono time. Winner in accent. Axis below, then one line of test conditions and a reproduce link.

Dark panel, radius 8-12, a real chart type: beeswarm of 5px dots with dim stepped percentiles, box-and-whisker with mono medians, heatmap of square cells. Footer legend explains it. Another panel fades behind at 50%.

One line 1.5-2px, optional fill fading to near-white, four ring markers or a live end dot, hairline grid, 12px axis labels, caption half accent, half ink. Width up to 1130px. Or a word set large over the line.
Box about 700px, 1px border at ink-6%, no radius. 37px rows: grey rank, 9px hue square, 13px name, 11px grey qualifier, right-aligned 110px bar in the same hue, 13px percent. 1px row rules.

Logo at centre with 1px spokes to 22px branches, each spraying finer spokes to 14px leaves. Labels fade from ink to 30% with depth and drift in on scroll. Or three concentric arcs, solid, dashed and dotted, carrying 24px logo chips.

Six equal cells split by 1px rules: 11-12px uppercase label, 18-20/700 value, 12px delta with coloured arrow. Selected cell tinted, radius 6-8, drives the chart below: 1.5px line, 10% fill, faint grid. Data has weekly rhythm.
A tiny widget with real data: 46px dial with one needle under 14px mono readout, or 197x35 sparkline with a 2.5px line and tinted fill and no axes, or four mono label-value rows at 21px pitch.

Descending isometric bars in 1px dotted outline on black, no axes, with only the winner solid and labelled in accent. Or a greyscale diagram with one dark outline, or a 230px outline pie with one accent slice.

Two 544px outlined panels of small rounded cells. One lights scattered rows, the other whole columns. Or dashed tiles with accent-tint fills and accent mono captions. No numbers: the arrangement argues.

Card up to 1080px, radius 8. Pill toggle switches scenarios. Solid history, dashed path, pale projection, soft filled areas. One 1px accent callout box with a vertical leader to a dot explains the key region.
2px line with end dot over a dotted 1px line, fine vertical hatching filling only the gap between them. 12px legend at the base, one baseline rule, no axes or gridlines. No colour needed.
Strip about 890x80 of 100 thin vertical bars, white with a soft tint midway. 54px/400 figure to its right with a 14px grey caption. Three 14px links with external icons below.
Grouped bars 44px wide with 4px gaps: yours in the accent, rivals in a warm grey. Rival logos sit inside bar tops. 12px bold mono values above, hairline gridlines, underlined group labels below.

Pale surface card 328x248, radius 16, 1.5px border. Range capsules at left, 9px mono labels, pale in-range zone, one dot joined by a 1px line to a later dot, date ticks below. Add a pause control if it animates.
Regions in 2px ink outline on a pale blob, one highlighted with 8% fill, white card with region name and price. Or a dark map with numbered clusters and a search overlay, radius 12.

CSS phone or nodes with concentric 1px rings, labelled pills attached by 1px lines with end dots. A small amount chip travels along the line, then rows update in sequence. Dashed variants work on saturated plates, in page type.

Composer types real prompts at 24-58ms a character with a slower pause on spaces, then send arrow fills, a shimmering Thinking line, then the answer. Panel tint changes per task. Modify and Replay buttons below. Start from a partial line.

Real DOM app window plays itself: a cursor moves on a 0.9s eased path, clicks, selection moves, inspector swaps with a 220ms crossfade, breadcrumb updates. Loop every 3-4s per step. 36-44px circular pause control. Rest on a designed frame.

Shell about 1000-1170px, 1px border. Top: dropdown, 3-step stepper, Pause, Start Over. Left code plus console, right event timeline drawing bars over gridlines. Or a right stepper with a 1px rail, dots and 19px labels. Plays automatically.

Board panel about 1320px, 60px gutters, soft shadow, dotted grid. Stickies, stamps, named cursors, a running timer and a spinning widget animate as rebuilt UI. It crosses the fold to invite scrolling.

Grid of 34-40px tiles with green checks and amber-outlined running jobs with counters, fading at the base. A floating white count card overlaps top right. Tiles change state one at a time, every 400ms.

spec: Black card up to 1260px, radius 28, centred 28px line and footage. Floating grey pill with a progress dash, five dots and a separate play or pause circle, docked in the card, parked below it on scroll.

110px disc inside two 1px concentric rings at about 200 and 296px, pastel chips sitting on the rings. Or arcs clipped by the cell bottom with a soft wedge sweeping round and one pill with a pulsing dot.
Full-bleed 320px band. 180px white cards, radius 4, slide left through a 4px vertical scan line: dashed wireframes before, finished UI with 32px check badges after. Loop seamlessly.

Pills above a real preview: active filled, content changes per value. Or a 664x404 panel, radius 24, with an image at left and five white mono pills at right, active tinted, each pill a real parameter name.

Frame 912x456, 2px white border, radius 0. Left panel grey boxes, right panel accent with white mono code. 1px divider, 32-44px white round handle with bracket glyph, mono caps corner labels. Auto-nudge once on enter.
Small working sample app beside a mono event table. New rows arrive tinted as the app is used, and a chart panel overlaps. Windows overlap with real shadows. The visitor generates the data.
Black code window, every line blurred except one, with that token highlighted and a floating type hover card in 14px mono with a hairline. The blur moves line to line, like a focus pull.
A sentence appears word by word on a rule with per-token numbers under it, a candidates list beside it, and a scrubber labelled 30x slowed down, from Detailed to Realtime.
Solid colour band. Five 197x268 tiles washed by the ground, centre tile 272x305 in full colour, raised with a shadow, 16px caption beneath. The wash cycles along the row.
